rationale: The distribution thesis is fully intact — price is printing fresh session lows ($8.35), remains ~5% below VWAP and below the 5m 9-EMA ($8.60) on 5.3x relative volume with a risk-off tape, and no reversal signal (no VWAP reclaim, no absorption, no higher low) has appeared.
